title: eludite/solution/open
description: Open a solution or project file. Increments the solution generation and returns it; load progress follows as eludite/solution/status.

path.description: Path to a .sln, .slnx or project file (.csproj, .vbproj, .fsproj). An .fsproj is not handed to Roslyn, which cannot load F#; it still loads for the tree, properties, configurations and tests (brief 0057).
